pcos.name: PCOS / PCOD
pcos.what: A common hormone condition. The ovaries may not release an egg every month.
pcos.signs: Late or missed periods, pimples, extra face hair, hair fall, weight gain.
pcos.when: If periods stay irregular for 3 months or more, or you find it hard to get pregnant.

endo.name: Endometriosis
endo.what: Tissue like the inside of the womb grows outside it. It can cause strong pain.
endo.signs: Very painful periods, pain during sex, heavy bleeding, pain in lower belly or back.
endo.when: If period pain stops daily work or painkillers do not help.

suggested.irregularPlus: Could my irregular periods alongside pimples, hair fall or weight changes be related to PCOS or thyroid?
suggested.painCycle: I have had severe period pain across multiple cycles. What could be causing it and what safe pain relief do you recommend?
suggested.heavyRepeat: I have had frequent heavy bleeding. Could this be making me anaemic or low on iron, and do I need an ultrasound?
suggested.irregularCycles: Could my irregular periods have an underlying cause that needs medical testing?
suggested.pelvicPain: I have noticed persistent pelvic pain. Are there specific scans or checks we should do?
suggested.heavyBleeding: My bleeding has been heavy at times. Should we check my haemoglobin level for anaemia?
suggested.medicineReview: Are all my current medications still needed, and are there any side effects or adjustments required?
suggested.generalTests: Are there any routine blood tests, vitamin checks, or scans recommended for me?
suggested.nutrition: What dietary changes or daily habits can help support my health and energy?
suggested.redFlags: What warning signs should prompt me to come back or go to the hospital right away?
suggested.followUp: When should I come in for my next check-up or follow-up visit?

pmjay.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
pmjay.shortDesc: Free hospital cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for eligible households.
pmjay.benefits: Up to ₹5 lakh per year per family for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
pmjay.documents: Aadhaar Card, Ration card / Food Security Card, PM-JAY letter or beneficiary ID.
pmjay.whereToApply: Ayushman Mitra desk at any empanelled government or private hospital, or nearest CSC (Common Service Centre).

arogyaMandir.name: Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health & Wellness Centres)
arogyaMandir.shortDesc: Free comprehensive primary healthcare and women's cancer screening.
arogyaMandir.benefits: Free daily OPD, essential medicines, diagnostic tests, antenatal care, and cervical, breast, and oral cancer screening for women aged 30+.
arogyaMandir.whereToApply: Your nearest village/ward Ayushman Arogya Mandir, Sub-Centre, or Primary Health Centre (PHC).

jsy.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
jsy.shortDesc: Cash assistance to promote safe institutional hospital delivery.
jsy.benefits: Direct cash assistance (₹700–₹1,400 depending on rural/urban and state) for delivering in a government hospital or accredited private facility.
jsy.documents: MCP Card (Mother and Child Protection card), Aadhaar Card, Bank passbook linked to Aadhaar.
jsy.whereToApply: Contact your local ASHA worker, ANM nurse, or register at the nearest PHC / Govt Maternity Hospital.

pmmvy.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
pmmvy.shortDesc: Maternity cash incentive of ₹5,000 – ₹6,000 in bank accounts.
pmmvy.benefits: Direct benefit transfer of ₹5,000 in instalments for first child (and ₹6,000 for second child if girl child) to support nutrition and rest.
pmmvy.documents: MCP card, Aadhaar cards of mother and husband, bank passbook in mother's name.
pmmvy.whereToApply: Anganwadi Centre (AWC), local ASHA worker, or online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

pmsma.name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
pmsma.shortDesc: Guaranteed free antenatal check-up on the 9th of every month.
pmsma.benefits: Free comprehensive clinical examination, ultrasound scan, blood & urine tests by medical officers and gynaecologists on the 9th of every month.
pmsma.documents: MCP Card, Aadhaar Card, previous ultrasound or test reports.
pmsma.whereToApply: Any government hospital, Community Health Centre (CHC), or designated PHC on the 9th of any month.

jssk.name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
jssk.shortDesc: Completely free, cashless delivery and newborn healthcare.
jssk.benefits: Zero out-of-pocket expenses: free normal delivery and C-section, free medicines, blood, diagnostics, food during stay, and free transport from home to hospital.
jssk.documents: MCP Card, Aadhaar card (no citizen is denied care even without documents).
jssk.whereToApply: Automatic entitlement at all public health facilities (PHC, CHC, District Hospital, Govt Maternity Hospital).
